title: Library catalogue
goal: Show library membership, loans, physical copies, titles, authors, and reservations.

rubric.must: Member visibly has many Loans and Copy visibly has many Loan records over time.
Title visibly has one or more physical Copy records.
Author and Title visibly connect through the Title Author associative entity.
Member and Title visibly both relate to Reservation.
Member, Loan, Copy, Title, Author, Reservation, and Title Author are visible as distinct entities.
The associative and lending entities visibly show their key fields.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the erd exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: All seven requested entities and their key fields are visible. The relationships are traceable and match the source data: members and copies each relate to many loans, titles have one or more copies, reservations connect members and titles, and authors connect to titles through TITLE_AUTHOR. Labels are readable, with no material overlap or cropping.

items.evidence: MEMBER connects to LOAN with one member to many loans; COPY connects to LOAN with one copy to many loan records over time.
TITLE connects to COPY with one title to one or more copies.
AUTHOR and TITLE connect through the visible TITLE_AUTHOR associative entity.
RESERVATION connects to both MEMBER and TITLE.
MEMBER, LOAN, COPY, TITLE, AUTHOR, RESERVATION, and TITLE_AUTHOR are visible as distinct entities.
LOAN shows loan_id, member_id, and copy_id; TITLE_AUTHOR shows title_id and author_id, with its key fields visibly marked.
